title: No no-follow directory metadata inspection
summary: Profile 0.18 provides bounded listing, entry names, kinds, mutation, and sync. The remaining filesystem gap is an explicit no-follow metadata query with file type, size, and symlink-safe inspection semantics.
requiredBehavior: Expose a capability-gated, bounded metadata/no-follow inspection operation whose result preserves unknown or unsupported platform states and cannot follow an untrusted path or symlink.

observation.summary: Current filesystem conformance proves listing and mutation, but no fs metadata/no-follow primitive is present in the capability inventory.

reproduction.instructions: attempt a bounded no-follow metadata query for a directory entry under an explicit fs_root grant

evidence.summary: fs_list and fs_write are present; metadata/no-follow inspection is absent.

workaround.description: mncs-store relies on Python os.stat/listdir behavior for metadata and recovery scans.
